{{Quote|One day I'll find my way home.|[[Dalien Brock]], one of the leaders of the Stargazer sect|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
The '''Stargazers''' cult was an organizations of fanatics active in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] at the height of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire's]] power. They were obsessed with leaving the [[Star system/Legends|star system]], believing they were robbed when the [[Tho Yor]] brought their ancestors to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] world [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] millennia in the past.

==Overview==
The Stargazers were a lesser sect active on the planet [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]] in [[25,793 BBY]]. One of many sects that sought to leave the Tython system, they were secretive and largely non-violent, with the [[Kalimahr militia]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lorus]] having had no dealings with them. Membership in the sect was largely kept private. Rumors abounded in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rhol Yan]] that the [[swing dust]] miner and industrialist [[Kara (Je'daii)|Kara]] was a private investor in the sect. Captain Lorus had intel that she was letting the cultists use her properties on Kalimahr, and may have provided them with funds. In fact, Kara had donated use of an abandoned [[Order of Dai Bendu|Dai Bendu]] [[Stargazers Temple|temple]] in the Kalimahr city of [[Khar]]. This sect of Stargazers was led by the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Shunned]] [[Dalien Brock]], who was dedicated to finding a way to leave [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] and to reach the [[Star/Legends|stars]] of their ancestors by all means possible, even criminal.<ref name="Into the Void" />

In [[25,793 BBY]] the Stargazer sect put into action its [[Stargazer Uprising|plot]] to develop a [[Gree device|device]] that would utilize [[Dark matter/Legends|dark matter]] to activate a [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] [[hypergate]] located in the [[Old City (Tython)|Old City]] on Tython. Using plans laid out in the Frontiersman [[Osamael Or]]'s journal titled ''[[The Gree, and Everything I Have Found of Them in the Old City]]'', the sect's members worked in the confines of the Temple to formulate a methodical plan that would take them across the system. First, they would travel to the weapons labs of [[Pan Deep]] in [[Greenwood Station]] to create the device, initiating a [[Tragedy of Greenwood Station|civil war]] between Greenwood and neighboring city [[Knool Tandor]]. Using the conflict to cover their movements, the sect would then travel to the planet [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]] wherein they would delve into the mines of [[Ran Dan's Folly]] to excavate [[marionium]] to charge the device and initiate the dark matter creation. In the pursuit of these goals, many members of the sect were willing to don suicide vests and detonate themselves in public places to prevent the agents of the [[Je'daii Council]] from stopping the plot.<ref name="Into the Void" />

The Stargazers were nearly successful with their plot, making it as far as the hypergate itself in the sub levels of the Old City on Tython itself. However in the final moment [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]], the sister of the sect's leader Dalien, killed her brother and prevented the activation of the gate. The device was taken to [[Anil Kesh]] for study, the Old City put under watch, and the financiers of the cult fled. Je'daii Brock speculated that the cult continued on, however. As Kara and others of great wealth disappeared without a trace, the Je'daii believed that they were the real leaders of the cult.<ref name="Into the Void" />
